meta.note: All products, brands, people, households and the local council in this portfolio are invented. Reference ranges, tax bands, WHO free-sugar guidance, energy arithmetic and geodesy/timing arithmetic are the real formulas a reader would meet.

medicines.name: Levothyroxine
medicines.missed: Take it as soon as you remember if it is more than 4 hours before your next iron or calcium dose; otherwise skip that day and carry on. Never double up.

medicines.name: Ramipril
rules: stand up slowly for the first week
medicines.missed: Take it when you remember on the same day. If it is nearly time for the next dose, skip the missed one.

medicines.name: Ferrous fumarate
medicines.food: 1 hour before food, with water or juice
rules: orange juice helps, tea and milk block it
medicines.missed: If you miss a dose, take it at least 2 hours away from your calcium tablets. Do not take two doses closer together than 6 hours.

medicines.name: Calcium carbonate
medicines.missed: Take it with your next meal. Keep it at least 2 hours away from the iron tablets.

medicines.name: Atorvastatin
medicines.food: any time, same time each day
rules: tell any prescriber about muscle pain
medicines.missed: Take it when you remember unless it is already the next day - then just carry on.

items.why: Tear it: the clean lid is cardboard, the greasy base is food waste. Never put the greasy half in recycling.
Drinking glass melts at a different temperature from bottles and jars. Wrap it and bin it.
Foil and plastic are fused. Kerbside cannot split them; the pharmacy takes them back.
Aluminium pods go in the metals bank, loose, not in a bag.
Never in any kerbside bin: they start fires in the lorry.
Empty is fine. Do not pierce them.
Paired shoes, bagged. Wet textiles are rejected.
No kerbside market. Supermarket front-of-store schemes take some.
Small electricals bank, or the kerbside small-appliance collection if booked.

recycling.rule_of_thumb: If it is smaller than a fist, it goes in the general waste - small items fall through the sorting screens and contaminate the recycling.
